tools.name: channel_packaging_gems
tools.description: Scan the entire YouTube channel for long-form videos whose average percentage viewed beats benchmark but whose thumbnail CTR is lagging, plus high-CTR / low-retention clickbait warnings. Use this when asked which thumbnails or titles to fix first.

tools.name: packaging_swap_impact
tools.description: Compare daily impressions, thumbnail CTR, retention, and revenue in the 12 days before vs 12 days after a recorded title or thumbnail change (e.g. vid_02 or vid_11).

tools.name: traffic_source_ctr_breakdown
tools.description: Break down thumbnail impressions, CTR, and average view percentage across BROWSE (Home), SUGGESTED, and YT_SEARCH from YouTube Bulk Reporting `channel_reach_combined_a1`.

tools.name: shorts_vs_longform_true_engagement
tools.description: Normalize raw views after YouTube's August 27, 2026 play-start counting change against Engaged Views, watch hours, and AdSense RPM across Shorts and long-form videos.

tools.name: rpm_and_sponsor_readiness_audit
tools.description: Summarize highest-RPM topics, audience geography, median 30-day engaged views, and suggested mid-roll sponsor rate card floor/target.

tools.name: sync_status_and_coverage
tools.description: Inspect OAuth read-only scopes, live Analytics API status, and archived YouTube Bulk Reporting CSV coverage (`channel_reach_basic_a1`).

tools.name: channel_weekly_brief_snapshot
tools.description: Return a compact (<1,500 token) weekly summary of packaging opportunities, recent thumbnail swap lift, and Shorts vs long-form revenue split.
